name: Elise Dubois
bio:
Elise's journey into motorsport began almost by accident. Initially apprenticed as an automotive refinisher, her meticulous attention to detail and exceptional color-matching skills quickly caught the eye of a local racing team. She joined them on a temporary basis, and became responsible for maintaining the team's livery. Elise thrived in the high-pressure environment, and after only a few seasons, she has earned a reputation for delivering flawless results, even under tight deadlines.

Her approach to the paint shop is scientific and methodical. She meticulously documents every process, ensuring consistency and repeatability. Elise isn't afraid to push boundaries, experimenting with new materials and techniques to achieve the perfect finish and improve aerodynamic efficiency. Her demanding nature ensures that every aspect of the job meets her exacting standards, producing superior results every time. She is now looking for a new challenge where her skills can be fully utilized.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Elise has a focused and intense gaze, reflecting her dedication to her work.

quirks: Insists on using a specific brand of polishing cloth.
Always listens to classical music while working to maintain focus.
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning her workspace after every task, no matter how small.
